metadata.title: The properties of dynamically ejected runaway and hyper-runaway stars

notes: No individual stars are identified. The paper presents statistical N-body simulations and population-level analysis of dynamically ejected runaway and hyper-runaway stars, but it does not identify any specific star whose present-day state is assessed as unbound from the Milky Way, nor does it perform follow-up on a previously identified Galactic unbound candidate.
